payload.label: Recheck every ruling on its own cadence
payload.job: Re-measure every ruling in the person's principles list that is due, by running its regression_sql with a 5 second timeout. A clean measure counts a pass; after widen_after_clean passes (3) the cadence steps 1, 2, 3, then 7 days. A measure over its ceiling is a regression: the cadence snaps back to 1 day, the number and the time are recorded as last_regressed_why, and one calendar task is opened for the owner lane. A ruling with no regression_sql is not measured and is not counted.
payload.produces: Counts only (checked, clean, regressed, unmeasured). Rulings are updated in principles; a regression opens one calendar task per ruling per day.

source.from: team lead, regression watcher job, Nov 21 2026
source.note: Every ruling is a principles row; this watcher is the one place cadence and snap-back are decided.

credential_name.description: The person's own database, as the switch's input names it (its vault name).

input.sql: SELECT row_to_json(x)::text FROM (SELECT count(*) AS checked, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'clean') AS clean, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'regressed') AS regressed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'unmeasured') AS unmeasured FROM recheck_due_rulings()) x
